description: Source code for retrieving and converting Android caption settings into internal C++ structures, including JNI interactions and accessibility feature mappings.

methods.name: AndroidEdgeTypeToSbEdgeStyle
methods.description: Converts Android edge type integer to internal caption character edge style enum.

methods.name: AndroidFontFamilyToSbFontFamily
methods.description: Converts Android font family integer to internal caption font family enum.

methods.description: Sets caption color, opacity, and their states based on JNI caption settings object.
